authoritative_for: Conatus owns captured want wording and source references, accepted decision-feed intake, the cursor baseline, frozen outgoing source documents, handoff receipts, local processing gates, and product views. It owns the instruction document selected in its dedicated Annals library.
Conatus owns complete daily wants rendering, frozen email occurrences and submission receipts; Email owns transport and Clockwork owns daily activation.
Conatus owns each want's explicit active or archived state and active selection in default lists and new emails. State does not propagate to Annals; no archival transition history is retained.
not_authoritative_for: Annals owns retained works, library and instruction identities, evidence, concept graph, reconciliations, revisions, inbox processing and model-result recovery. Krisis owns decision identification; accepted accounts do not prove enactment or current force. Nucleus owns model execution and Clockwork owns activation, configured scheduling failure enforcement and notifications.

covers: Public Conatus want capture, explicit archival and unarchival, library exploration, initialization, decision-feed update, instruction selection, bounded recovery, local pause, installation and schedule preparation in this release.
Deterministic daily email preview, manual and scheduled submission, exact retained previews and explicit bounded submission retry.
excludes: Help/version display, internal implementation, direct database edits, historical imports, task planning, progress measurement, public sharing, and current installation or runtime readiness.

shared_access_and_trust: Interfaces are local current-user CLI operations over explicitly selected private state and pinned Annals libraries. Each operation states its own effects; read access is not mutation or disclosure authority.
shared_privacy_and_retention: Conatus state retains source wording, complete documents, references and handoff documents. Annals and Nucleus can retain complete sources and model context during interpretation. Personal email separately discloses its exact content through Email. Frozen messages remain in private settings storage. No automatic pruning or deletion interface is supplied.

CLI usage recording requires a nonempty `CODEX_THREAD_ID`. Chancery's private journal records command identity, time, and thread ID, not arguments, output, or outcomes. Internal product calls are excluded. Recording errors do not change command results.
compatibility_and_retirement: Conatus provider release and entry versions are distinct from its state schema, Annals schemas and Nucleus/Clockwork contracts. No general deprecation or compatibility window is promised.
operational_limits: List reads default to 20 with a maximum of 100. Source capture accepts one nonblank UTF-8 want. Background activation is separately selected and does not promise a completion time. No storage capacity, throughput or service-level objective is promised.
